name: PBQ Arizona 2025
information:
Arizona's first Please Be Quiet (PBQ) competition!  This is competition will only have quiet events, and will not have the regular 3x3 event.  Since this is a quiet competition, spectators and competitors are expected to be quiet and minimize noise during events.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQArizona2025#59226-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
